description: This file contains source code for managing network connections in a Git environment, including protocols like SSH, file, and git protocols. It handles URL parsing, capability negotiation with the server, connection establishment, and transport-specific functionalities.

methods.name: int check_ref(const char * name,unsigned int flags)
methods.description: Checks if a reference name matches specified flags such as normal refs, branches, or tags.

methods.name: int check_ref_type(const struct ref * ref,int flags)
methods.description: Validates a reference object against flags.

methods.name: NORETURN void die_initial_contact(int unexpected)
methods.description: Handles unexpected hangups or read errors during initial contact with the remote repository, terminating the program with an error message.
